snapshot.text: Two-tier system with public hospitals for most people and private care for the insured minority. Under the 'Vision April 2026' reform senior officials must use public hospitals, alongside investment in infrastructure, staff and ambulances.

minister.name: Esperance Luvindao
minister.role: Minister of Health and Social Services

priorities.title: Vision April 2026
priorities.text: Officials must use public facilities, with a facility assessment and reforms to raise quality.

priorities.title: 60 ambulances in three years
priorities.text: The ministry promises 60 ambulances over three years.

priorities.title: Digital health policy
priorities.text: A national digital health policy was launched.
